key.title: Stream key
key.generated: Key generated — copy it now, it won't be shown in full again
key.copyFailed: Could not copy — maybe the key has not been created yet

chat.title: Chat
chat.reconnectFailed: Could not reconnect to the chat. Reload the page.

chatApi.hint: Send to the chat: POST /api/chat/send with the header Authorization: Bearer key
chatApi.generated: Chat key generated — copy it or the OBS link

regen.title: Generate a new key?
regen.text: The old key stops working immediately — if a stream is running with it, it will be cut off.

resetModal.title: Restore the default window layout?
resetModal.text: All moved and resized windows will return to their original places.

chatRegen.title: Generate a new chat key?
chatRegen.text: The old key will stop working: the OBS overlay, bots and bridges will need the new one.
